device.model: InfiniiVision DSOX1204A and compatible SCPI oscilloscopes
device.name: Keysight InfiniiVision oscilloscope over SCPI (osc.scope.Scope)

facts.text: The project targets a Keysight DSOX1204A and other benchtop oscilloscopes supporting USBTMC and SCPI
The module is the SCPI driver layer of the Keysight InfiniiVision series and depends only on pyvisa over NI-VISA USBTMC
The connection is a pyvisa ResourceManager and an open VISA resource with newline terminators and a timeout from config.TIMEOUT_MS
The SCPI timeout defaults to 10000 ms and can be overridden with SCOPE_TIMEOUT_MS
write sends one command line and query returns one stripped reply line
identify queries *IDN? and splits the reply into manufacturer, model, serial and firmware
status reads the timebase, all channels, the edge trigger and the acquisition type and points
autoscale, run, stop and single send :AUToscale, :RUN, :STOP and :SINGle
configure_channel writes scale, offset, coupling, display and probe ratio on a channel
ChannelSetting documents scale in V/div and offset in V
configure_timebase sets the mode and the s/div scale and position in seconds
configure_trigger writes the edge source, level, slope and sweep
capture asks for :WAVeform:POINts?, transfers :WAVeform:DATA? as 8-bit samples, converts the preamble and decimates the envelope using max_return
The clone declares NO_MEASUREMENT=9.9e36 for measurements that cannot be made
The numeric parser returns None for an absent or unparsable value and values whose absolute value is at least half of NO_MEASUREMENT
measure queries :MEASure:<item>? CHANnel<n> for each requested item
The V/div table spans 1 mV/div to 5 V/div and the s/div table 2 ns/div to 50 s/div in 1-2-5 steps
The web control accepts coupling DC/AC, slope POS/NEG/EITH, sweep AUTO/NORM, timebase mode MAIN/XY/ROLL, and probe ratios 1/10/100/1000
The web trigger-source parser accepts CHANNELn or CHANn when n is within config.CHANNEL_COUNT, plus EXT
The channel count is configurable with SCOPE_CHANNEL_COUNT and defaults to four
errors queries :SYSTem:ERRor? up to 32 times, stops at a reply beginning +0 and returns other replies
The web control clamps a trigger level to -1000 V and 1000 V before sending it
The clone requests 2000 waveform points and decimates to at most 500 by default
A logged session shows the automatic measurement commands as :MEASure:VPP? CHANnel1 and :MEASure:FREQuency? CHANnel1

operator_required.name: channel1_scale_v_per_div
operator_required.reason: the clone lists the 1-2-5 V/div table (osc/scales.py:15-16) but says the table endpoints follow the manual and must be checked on the unit; the site supplies the range of its instrument

operator_required.name: channel1_offset_v
operator_required.reason: the clone states no offset range and its own clamp is only a guard (osc/scales.py:25-31); the limit depends on the vertical scale and the probe ratio of the installed instrument

operator_required.name: timebase_scale_s_per_div
operator_required.reason: the clone lists the 1-2-5 s/div table (osc/scales.py:18-23) but says the table endpoints follow the manual and must be checked on the unit; the site supplies the range of its instrument

operator_required.name: timebase_position_s
operator_required.reason: the clone states no horizontal-position range; its clamp (osc/scales.py:25-31) is a guard, not the instrument bound, which depends on the timebase scale

operator_required.name: trigger_source
operator_required.reason: the operator lists trigger sources present on the installed instrument

operator_required.name: trigger_level_v
operator_required.reason: the web clamp is a control guard, not an instrument range; the operator supplies the trigger-level envelope
